messages:
liz: Quick heads-up: published redwood-plugins v0.5.1 (Dev Day patch). Small UX improvements to scaffolder + config renames. Release: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-plugins/releases/tag/v0.5.1 :tada:
ci-bot: Release detected: redwood-plugins v0.5.1 by @liz (checks: unit, lint) 
sam: Nice. What's the breaking rename?
liz: Two changes: 1) plugin.yaml -> plugin.config.yaml (note the .config), 2) the `handler` field becomes `entry_point`. Both easy to migrate; we included a tiny migrate script and a sample sed/jq snippet in docs.
liz: Migration example:
```
# quick migrate: plugin.yaml -> plugin.config.yaml
jq '."plugin.config.yaml" = ."plugin.yaml" | .entry_point = .handler | del(.handler)' plugin.yaml > plugin.config.yaml
```
chris: For Dedicated customers: will older images still work?
liz: Yes, we added a compatibility shim: redwoodctl will accept both names for 30 days and log a deprecation warning. But recommend running `redwoodctl plugins refresh` after upgrading to pick up new metadata. We'll call this out in the TL;DR in the release notes.
maria: I can host an office hours drop-in for maintainers tomorrow 11am PT to walk through migrations and the new scaffolder options. I'll post calendar invite.
devrel: I'll schedule a short video walkthrough and add a community announcement + forum post. Also pro-tip: the scaffolder now generates unit-test stubs for plugins.
sam: I'll add a GitHub Actions lint to fail when `handler` is present and open PR later today.
ci-bot: Issue created: #356 "lint: fail on legacy plugin handler key" by @sam 
liz: Thanks — tagging maintainers for visibility @maria @sam @chris. Plan is: soft announce to community channel now, newsletter blurb tonight, broader social tomorrow.
maria: Sounds good. If folks want to rehearse migration, join the office hours link I'll post in #community-calendar.
chris: Congrats team, looks smooth.
liz: Appreciate everyone who helped test the scaffolder and the migration path. Ping me in #devex if anything pops up. :rocket:
